source.mhfsdt: the game client's dat/mhfsdt.bin (not in our patch)

moves.name: Upswing (Earth/Heaven/Storm)
moves.desc: Upswing in the hand-coded styles; same 58 as the Extreme upswing record 164, and Storm lists it as the uncharged/Lv1 upswing (MV 58)
moves.input: Upswing button

moves.name: Horizontal Slash
moves.desc: Sweeping slash left to right; also spawned by the combo/evade variants of the action (actions 0,5-8,37,38) (MV 46)
moves.input: Horizontal Slash button

moves.name: Vertical Slash (uncharged)
moves.desc: Overhead slash; also the uncharged release of the Earth/Extreme charge (event 18, charge level 0) (MV 60)
moves.input: Vertical Slash button

moves.name: Kick
moves.desc: Short quick kick-like hit; name from the structure only (action 4, a separate one-record action with a very short active window) (MV 2)
Same shape as record 4 but slower start; no action spawns it, only the weapon signature ties it to GS (MV 2)
Only a weak weapon signature; no action, no community move with 54 (MV 54)
Only a weak weapon signature; no action, no community move with 50 (MV 50)

moves.name: Vertical charge Lv1
moves.desc: Earth/Extreme vertical charge slash released at charge level 1 (event 18 picks 91) (MV 85)
moves.input: Hold Vertical Slash, release at Lv1

moves.name: Vertical charge Lv2
moves.desc: Earth/Extreme vertical charge slash at charge level 2; same MV as the Horizontal Finisher (record 156) but this one is in the Charge Attack Up list (MV 105)
moves.input: Hold Vertical Slash, release at Lv2

moves.name: Vertical charge Lv3
moves.desc: Earth/Extreme maximum vertical charge slash; hit type 27 like the Storm Lv4 charge (MV 146)
moves.input: Hold Vertical Slash, release at Lv3

moves.desc: Only a weak weapon signature; no action, no community move (MV 1)
Only a weak weapon signature; no action, no community move (MV 1)

moves.name: Guard Slash, 0 guards
moves.desc: Heaven/Storm diagonal slash with a guard point, no successful guard (event 19 = 110 + guard count); also in the Extreme action table (actions 33-36) although the wiki says Extreme has no guard slash (MV 48)
moves.input: Guard Slash button (Heaven/Storm)

moves.name: Guard Slash, 1 guard
moves.desc: Guard Slash after 1 successful guard on the way (event 19 = 110 + 1) (MV 107)
moves.input: Guard Slash button, block 1 hit

moves.name: Guard Slash, 2 guards
moves.desc: Guard Slash after 2 successful guards (MV 156)
moves.input: Guard Slash button, block 2 hits

moves.name: Guard Slash, 3 guards
moves.desc: Guard Slash after 3 successful guards (the wiki cap) (MV 215)
moves.input: Guard Slash button, block 3 hits

moves.name: Guard Slash, 4 guards
moves.desc: Same 215 as 3 guards; likely the guard count above 3 (the Guard Slash sigil adds +1 count per sigil, so 3 guards + 1 sigil) (MV 215)
moves.input: Guard Slash button, block 3+ hits with Guard Slash sigil

moves.name: Guard Slash, 5 guards
moves.desc: Same 215 as 3 guards; likely guard count 5 (with two Guard Slash sigils) (MV 215)
moves.input: Guard Slash button, block 3+ hits with Guard Slash sigils

moves.name: Vertical Finisher, hit 1 (thrust)
moves.desc: 1st hit of the Vertical Finisher: sword pushed forward, then record 155 (MV 45)
moves.input: Guard + Vertical Slash after a vertical slash (Extreme: Vertical Slash again)

moves.name: Vertical Finisher, hit 2 (rising slash)
moves.desc: 2nd hit of the Vertical Finisher: vertical slash upward behind; does not launch allies (MV 76)
moves.input: Guard + Vertical Slash after a vertical slash (Extreme: Vertical Slash again)

moves.name: Horizontal Finisher
moves.desc: Reverse right-to-left sweep after a horizontal slash; same MV as Lv2 Charge (record 92) (MV 105)
moves.input: Guard + Horizontal Slash after a horizontal slash (Extreme: Horizontal Slash again)

moves.name: Upswing Finisher
moves.desc: Two-handed overhead chop after an upswing (MV 117)
moves.input: Guard + Upswing after an upswing (Extreme: Upswing again)

moves.name: Upswing (Extreme)
moves.desc: Extreme upswing, own action 54 (separate from the charge actions 55-58) (MV 58)
moves.input: Upswing button

moves.name: Upswing charge Lv1
moves.desc: Storm/Extreme charged upswing at level 1 (Storm calc lists 58 here, text and wiki say 92) (MV 92)
moves.input: Hold Upswing, release at Lv1

moves.name: Upswing charge Lv2
moves.desc: Storm/Extreme charged upswing at level 2 (MV 112)
moves.input: Hold Upswing, release at Lv2

moves.name: Upswing charge Lv3
moves.desc: Storm/Extreme charged upswing at level 3 (MV 157)
moves.input: Hold Upswing, release at Lv3

moves.name: Upswing charge Lv4
moves.desc: Storm/Extreme maximum charged upswing (timed window; drops to Lv2 if held too long); hit type 27 (MV 200)
moves.input: Hold Upswing, release at Lv4

moves.desc: Only a weak weapon signature; the number matches the guide key id of Guard Slash, which is not the record (MV 15)
Only a weak weapon signature; no action, no community move (MV 25)

moves.name: Dash Slash
moves.desc: Extreme: quick upswing out of the unsheathed dash, with a short invulnerable start; MV 60 like the Vertical Slash but its own action (64) (MV 60)
moves.input: Upswing button during the unsheathed dash (Extreme)

moves.name: Guard Downslash (after Just Guard)
moves.desc: Extreme: tornado-shaped overhead slash after a successful Just Guard; same 200 as the Lv4 charge but own action 68 and guard-type reaction 39 (MV 200)
moves.input: After a successful Just Guard, attack button (Vertical Slash)

moves.name: Guard Horizontal Slash (after Just Guard)
moves.desc: Extreme: quick right-to-left sweep after a successful Just Guard (MV 125)
moves.input: After a successful Just Guard, attack button (Horizontal Slash)

moves.name: Shining Sword, one hit
moves.desc: One hit of the Shining Sword aura (up to 17 hits; Charge Attack Up raises 27 to 40/47) (MV 27)
moves.input: Shining Sword button after 3 Just Guards (Extreme)

moves.name: Shining Sword, activation object
moves.desc: MV 0 object with a 60-frame window spawned from the GS code (0x1027c5a0); probably part of the Shining Sword (aura/charge-up), not seen as damage (MV 0)
moves.input: Shining Sword button after 3 Just Guards (Extreme)
